context.body: Some details repeat Genesis directly; other statements are Hebrews’ explicit interpretation of the earlier text and its silences.
context.label: Later analysis remains later analysis

observations.body: Hebrews retells Melchizedek’s meeting with Abraham, interprets his titles, comments on genealogy, and reasons from blessing, tenth, mortality, and descent.
observations.label: The Genesis meeting becomes an argument

observations.body: The unit moves from retelling and name interpretation to a call to consider greatness, then to Levitical tithes and Levi’s relation to Abraham.
observations.label: Narration expands into inference

payload.posture: Inspect Hebrews 7:1–10 as a bounded source before following its claims into another passage.
payload.tension: “Without father, without mother, without genealogy” and “remains a priest continually” can exceed what Genesis narrates if detached from Hebrews’ comparison and wording.
payload.title: Hebrews rereads Melchizedek’s meeting with Abraham
